goal: What was the longest distance covered in a mountain biking activity in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.
summary:
I answered **4506** meters, but that number is a conversion from a rounded figure, so the last digit may be off.

The only mountain biking activity I found this week (Monday Oct 9 to Sunday Oct 15) is "Mindful Movement" on Tuesday, October 10. I picked it out by its mountain-bike icon, not by opening it to read the category name. The app shows its distance in miles to two decimals: 2.80 mi. That converts to about 4506 m, but the true distance could be anywhere from about 4498 to 4514 m. I didn't switch the app to metric, because it would still round to two decimals (4.51 km) and give no meter-level precision.

The rest of the week's activities are swimming, rowing, surfing, bike touring and skiing. The trip list had no entries for today or Monday.
